mechanics.executable_reminder: If you cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, activated a nonmana ability this turn, and attacked this turn, you are in your renaissance for the rest of the game.

rule_text.name: 702.267a
rule_text.rule: Golden age on an instant or sorcery spell represents a spell ability. It means “If you've cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, activated a nonmana ability this turn, and attacked this turn, and you're not in a renaissance, you're in a renaissance for the rest of the game.”

rule_text.name: 702.267b
rule_text.rule: Golden age on a permanent represents a static ability. It means “Any time you've cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, activated a nonmana ability this turn, and attacked this turn, and you're not in a renaissance, you're in a renaissance for the rest of the game”

rule_text.name: 702.267c
rule_text.rule: Being in a renaissance is a designation that has no rules meaning other than to act as a marker that other rules and effects can identify. Any number of players may be in a renaissance at the same time.

rule_text.name: 702.267d
rule_text.rule: After a player enters a renaissance, continuous effects are reapplied before the game checks to see if the game state or preceding events have matched any trigger conditions.
